blockers.description: Phase 2 cannot auto-transition. `phase uat-passed 02 --require-verification` returns passed:false with blocker `02-UAT.md: test 1 (skipped)`, because uat-predicate.cjs:43 defines PASSING_RESULTS as exactly {pass, passed} and :235 blocks on every other result - a justified skip included.
blockers.workaround: Operator accepted this on 2026-08-11 and chose to proceed. Phase 2 is executed and verified but not transitioned; ROADMAP.md and STATE.md still show it open by design. Does NOT block Phase 3, which depends only on Phase 1 and touches disjoint files.

human_actions_pending.action: Optional - enable Docker Desktop > Settings > Resources > WSL Integration for Ubuntu, then clone the repo into the WSL ext4 home (NOT /mnt/c) and re-run /gsd-verify-work 02
human_actions_pending.context: The only legitimate path to marking UAT test 1 as pass and letting Phase 2 transition. /mnt/c is served by drvfs which fakes file ownership, so it would not exercise the uid/gid semantics the test exists for. Verified still-disabled on 2026-08-11: `wsl -d Ubuntu -- docker version` resolves docker only to the Windows binary under /mnt/c and refuses to run.

decisions.decision: Resolved blocked UAT test 1 as `skipped` with a re-verified reason rather than leaving it `blocked`
decisions.rationale: Operator has no macOS or Linux host. The blocker was re-confirmed live at verification time rather than inherited from the previous session's note.

decisions.decision: Did NOT record test 1 as `pass` to satisfy the transition predicate
decisions.rationale: That would assert the POSIX half of ROADMAP SC1 was behaviourally exercised when it never has been - exactly the overclaim 02-VERIFICATION.md was careful to avoid.

decisions.decision: Did NOT hand-edit ROADMAP.md or STATE.md to mark Phase 2 complete
decisions.rationale: The transition predicate is the authority. Forcing the checkbox would make the ledger claim something the predicate disagrees with. Documented the gap instead.

decisions.decision: Canonicalized 02-VERIFICATION.md status to `passed` per the verify-work workflow
decisions.rationale: It was human_needed waiting only on this UAT, which recorded zero issues. Its `behavior_unverified: 1` frontmatter field still records the POSIX gap, so the nuance survives the status change.

context_notes: This session was a UAT close-out pass on Phase 2, not a build pass. Nothing is mid-flight; no code was written and no backend file was touched.
